title: 'This Is Illegal': Stop Killing Games Distances Itself from GTA 6 Leaks
description: As an extended look at GTA 6 approaches, a group known as Cyberleek has leaked video footage. The Stop Killing Games movement has urged fans not to send money to them.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Stop Killing Games Movement Distances Itself from GTA 6 Leaks

Excitement for *GTA 6* continues to reach fever pitch as we approach the game's scheduled launch later this year. This week marks a major milestone for Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster, with the debut of an extended look at the game providing our very first official glimpse of the title in action ahead of release.

Unfortunately, this anticipated period has been disrupted by a spate of leaked videos emerging online over the past week. These unauthorized leaks have been attributed to an individual or group referring to themselves as Cyberleek. In response to these events, the "Stop Killing Games" movement has issued a strong warning to the gaming community, explicitly telling fans: "Do not send these people your money."

### Protecting the Integrity of the Community

The emergence of these leaks threatens the carefully planned promotional rollout managed by Rockstar Games. While gaming communities are always hungry for any piece of media related to *GTA 6*, the appearance of unauthorized footage distributed by groups like Cyberleek crosses legal and ethical boundaries. The swift public distancing by the Stop Killing Games movement highlights a collective industry and community stance against supporting illicit distribution methods.

As analysis suggests, mainstream advocacy groups must protect their credibility by immediately separating their legitimate consumer rights campaigns from illegal data breaches and leaks. By taking a hardline stance against the perpetrators, the movement ensures that its core mission remains untainted by association with illegal activity.

## Editor's Take
With the official extended look at *GTA 6* arriving this week, players finally have a legitimate way to experience the game before launch. It is crucial for the gaming community to ignore unauthorized leaks from sources like Cyberleek and instead support official channels to ensure a healthy industry environment.
